verdict.rationale: Kushki documents its own client-side tokenization tooling: a JS library marketed as "Máxima seguridad con PCI de Kushki", kushki.js, a hosted customizable payment form (Kajita) and a redirect payment button to a secure portal. It also contrasts "direct charge (without token)" with token-based flows. That points to card data being tokenized off the merchant's servers, but the evidence is mostly page titles and taglines, with no explicit statement of PCI scope reduction. missing for 10: explicit documentation that card data never reaches merchant servers, stated PCI DSS scope/SAQ level reduction (e.g., SAQ A), detail on the tokenization flow, independent corroboration.
